Adani’s Exit from Fortune Oil: What’s Next for AWL?
Adani Enterprises has exited AWL Agri Business (formerly Adani Wilmar) by selling its remaining 30.42% stake for ₹10,874 crore. This move helps Adani focus on core sectors like energy and infrastructure. Meanwhile, AWL is shifting from a low-margin edible oil business to a value-added FMCG player. It’s focusing on geographic expansion, digital sales, and premium products—but faces tough competition and brand-building challenges.
